actual.name: duplicate_exposing_symbol
actual.hint:
Each exposed symbol may appear only once in an import exposing list.

Example:
    import Banking.Proofs exposing balance_never_negative, transfer_preserves_total

actual.name: duplicate_import
actual.hint:
Each imported module may appear only once.

Example:
    import Banking.Types
    import Banking.Proofs

actual.name: module_self_import
actual.hint:
A module cannot import itself.

Example:
    module App.Main
    import Banking.Proofs
    end App.Main

actual.name: range_requires_numeric_base
actual.hint:
Only Integer and Double based types may declare ranges.

Examples:
    type Percent is Integer range 0..100
    type Temperature is Double range -273.15..10000.0

actual.name: duplicate_type_declaration
actual.hint:
Each type name may be declared only once in a module.

Use a new name or remove the duplicate declaration.

actual.name: invalid_range_bounds

actual.name: builtin_type_redefinition

Built-in Freehold types cannot be redefined.

Built-in types:
    Integer, Boolean, Double, String

actual.name: reserved_keyword_name
actual.message: reserved keyword cannot be used as name
actual.hint:
Reserved Freehold words cannot be used as user-defined names.

actual.name: duplicate_record_field

        id: Integer

    end record

actual.name: duplicate_record_literal_field
actual.hint:
A record literal may assign each field only once.

Remove the duplicate field initializer.

actual.name: field_access_requires_record

actual.name: unknown_record_literal_field

actual.name: array_length_mismatch

An array literal must match the fixed size declared by its Array type.

actual.hint:
Array indexes must be Integer expressions.

Index access requires an Array value before the brackets.

Example:
    xs[0]

actual.name: duplicate_parameter_name
actual.hint:
Each routine parameter name may appear only once in the parameter list.

Use distinct names for every parameter.

actual.name: function_missing_guaranteed_return
actual.hint:
Every function must guarantee a return statement.

Add a return statement on all paths through the function body.

actual.name: function_return_type_mismatch
actual.hint:
A function return expression must match the declared return type.

Check the function's `returns` clause and the returned expression.

actual.name: procedure_return_value
actual.hint:
Procedures do not return values.

Use a function when a routine needs to produce a value.

actual.name: unknown_routine
actual.hint:
A call must name a declared routine.

Declare the function or procedure before calling it.

actual.name: routine_argument_count_mismatch
actual.hint:
A routine call must pass exactly the parameters declared by the routine.

Check the routine declaration and update the argument list.

actual.name: routine_argument_type_mismatch
actual.hint:
Routine arguments must match the declared parameter types.

Check the parameter declaration for the expected type.

actual.name: assignment_type_mismatch
actual.hint:
The expression on the right side of an assignment must match the target type.

Check the target declaration and the assigned expression.

actual.name: case_branch_type_mismatch
actual.hint:
Each case branch value must have the same base type as the case expression.

Use branch values that match the expression after `case`.

actual.name: statement_requires_boolean
actual.hint:
This statement position requires a Boolean expression.

Use a comparison or Boolean expression such as `amount > 0` or `ready = true`.

actual.name: duplicate_case_branch_value
actual.hint:
Each literal case branch value may appear only once.

Remove the duplicate branch or merge its body into the first branch.

actual.name: unknown_assignment_target
actual.hint:
Assignment requires an existing local variable.

Declare the variable with `let` before assigning to it.

actual.name: while_variant_requires_integer
actual.hint:
A while variant must be an Integer expression.

Variants are used as numeric progress measures for loop termination reasoning.

actual.name: arithmetic_operand_mismatch
actual.hint:
Arithmetic operators require numeric operands.

Use Integer or Double expressions with `+`, `-`, `*`, and `/`.

actual.name: boolean_operator_operand_mismatch
actual.hint:
Boolean operators require Boolean operands on both sides.

Use comparisons to produce Boolean values before combining them with `and` or `or`.

actual.name: comparison_type_mismatch
actual.hint:
Equality comparisons require both sides to have the same base type.

Compare values of matching types, or convert the value before comparing it.

actual.name: ordering_comparison_operand_mismatch
actual.hint:
Ordering comparisons require numeric operands.

Use `<`, `<=`, `>`, and `>=` with Integer or Double expressions.

actual.name: unary_negative_requires_numeric
actual.hint:
The unary `-` operator requires a numeric operand.

actual.name: unary_not_requires_boolean
actual.hint:
The unary `not` operator requires a Boolean operand.

Example:
    not ready
